metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Passaic County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Totowa Borough Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.934%, with an equalization ratio of 51.5%.
Public education represents 48.2% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 34.6%.
Average residential assessment is $290,975, producing an average annual tax bill of $8,537.21.

equityAnalysis.summary: Totowa Borough maintains a consistent residential tax base across its residential zones.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Totowa Borough, homeowners pay an average of $8,537.21 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 7.44% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 51.5%, assessed values average ~51.5% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 48.2% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 34.6%, and Passaic County claims 17.2%.
